scope: Three rotated paired trials: frozen pre-lifecycle VFS versus Stage E VFS; actual warm-proxy BuildBuddy RBE acceptance, not a shallow-checkout comparison. Exclusive no-build/no-other-benchmark load window.

workload.semantic_edit: One fsynced separator byte in src/main/cpp/util/strings.cc, A through H; same-size edits, full tracked git status before each build.

method.startup_boundary: Clone launch to successful first build process exit; mapping import, mount and overlapping prefetch included; no prior query.
method.cycle_boundary: Edit worker launch through git status to successful remote build process exit; includes handovers; hash verification and safe RPC log summaries afterward.
method.percentiles: p50 median; p95 nearest rank. Twenty-four cycles per arm are correlated within three cells; per-trial results retained.
method.action_policy: CppCompile, CppArchive and CppLink execute remotely without action-cache hits; r2c2 repository reads remain enabled.
method.failure_policy: No failed/excluded/retried matrix cells; all outliers retained.
timed_phase_notes: Edit includes Python worker startup, one-byte pwrite and fsync.
Initial source-fixture materialization is measured separately before steady-state edit cycles.
Nested action metrics overlap and must not be added as critical-path phases.

setup_excluded.full_upstream_mirror_population: Not measured; preexisting standalone full mirror supplied.
setup_excluded.shared_archive_and_bazel_installation_ca: Warm; source clone, overlay, output base and local repository-contents cache fresh per cell.
setup_excluded.remote_workspace_cas: Prewarmed and settled before client timing.
setup_excluded.toolchain_image_provisioning: Excluded; identical immutable repository override verified before/after.

cleanup.raw_private_rpc_and_workspace_logs: Summarized using safe field parsers then deleted; no secret-bearing logs included.

interpretation: First-build and pooled cycle medians are modestly lower, but this does not establish a broad reliable end-to-end speedup.
Per-trial cycle medians are mixed: candidate lower in trial 1, slightly higher in trials 2 and 3.
Candidate 5.077346-second final cycle retained; its CppCompile queue metric is 1.659 seconds. Action metrics overlap and are not additive wall phases.
Each cell has 47 base digest hits, eight actual local hashes and zero misses. Candidate reports zero local_cache_hits: cache reuse is not established by this workload.
Each startup has 34 successful repository lookup RPCs; all 48 warm edit builds have zero repository lookup requests, not evidence of additional remote-cache hits.
These compare two VFS implementations, not VFS versus shallow checkout.
